name: Form 4 Biology: The Human Eye
subject: Biology
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to draw and label the human eye
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to explain how the eye forms images
learningActivities: Discussion: how do we see objects?
Diagram work: teacher uses an eye diagram to explain the parts
Group work: learners draw and label the eye
Explanation: learners describe the role of the lens and retina
keyPoints: The lens focuses light onto the retina
The iris controls the amount of light entering the eye
The retina contains light-sensitive cells that send signals to the brain
commonMisconceptions: Confusing the pupil with the iris
Thinking the image is formed in front of the retina
lessonEvaluation: Learners draw and label the eye and explain image formation.
teacherReflection: Good diagrams. Relate to short-sightedness and long-sightedness next lesson.
